summary: Unfold both Selmer conditions: cocycle, continuity, local conditions and inertia.

steps.claim: x is a continuous cocycle vanishing on the inertia above the places off P ∪ Q (selmerModule_mono from S to P ∪ Q, mem_selmerModule_iff, locally constant implies continuous).
Its restrictions lie in the local cocycles for K (x itself is in the Selmer module for K ⊆ L), and a totally complex field has no complex conjugation to vanish on.
